cases.description:
Error while using the new Connector Function calling impl.

System.InvalidCastException: 'Cannot cast Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions.OpenAPI.Model.RestApiOperationResponse to System.String'

A change to the code will be needed to handle <object> instead of strings.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: .Net BugBash Bugfix Example 59 - FunctionCalling (Added default serialization to Method Function results)
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
.Net BugBash Bugfix Example 59 - FunctionCalling (Added default serialization to Method Function results)

### Motivation and Context

Resolves #3829 

### Description

An error happened when attepting to convert Method functions to string while sending back to the LLM. 
To resolve the issue the value regardless of the type is converted to a JsonString and used as response.

Another bug was found while detecting the StreamingRole where only one chunk will have the role, not all.
